item.title: Show books collection dynamic with Javascript
item.description:
On this website, I have a bookcollection. All the books I have on my Kindle, are displayed here. Showing the cover, a summary, key takeaways. In addition to that, I have added tags to each book, so I can filter the collection and only show the books with that specific tag.

However, these pages with books per tag are a lot more boring than the general collection of books, where we are showing all the covers. So, showing the books with covers on the filtered pages would be nice. But, when thinking about that, it seems that having the content for the book-information in a csv or a JSON is a lot more practical: easier to maintain and update, faster to display and filter.

item.title: jQuery Pocket Reference: Read Less, Learn More
item.description:
jQuery Pocket Reference: Read Less, Learn More by David Flanagan

Summary

“jQuery Pocket Reference: Read Less, Learn More” by David Flanagan is a concise guide tailored for web developers who want to harness the power of jQuery, a popular JavaScript library. The book serves as both a quick introduction and a handy reference, detailing essential jQuery features, functions, and techniques to simplify and enhance JavaScript programming. It covers fundamental jQuery concepts such as event handling, DOM manipulation, animations, and AJAX functionality, providing clear examples and succinct explanations to facilitate quick learning and implementation.

item.title: A Smarter Way to Learn JavaScript: The new approach that uses technology to cut your effort in half
item.description:
A Smarter Way to Learn JavaScript: The New Approach That Uses Technology to Cut Your Effort in Half

Summary

“A Smarter Way to Learn JavaScript” by Mark Myers is a beginner-friendly programming guide designed to simplify the process of learning JavaScript. The book employs a unique approach that leverages interactive exercises on a companion website to reinforce concepts as they are introduced. This method is intended to help readers retain information better by combining reading with practice. Each chapter in the book is concise and focused on specific JavaScript features, ensuring learners can grasp and apply concepts progressively.

item.title: 3D Game Programming for Kids: Create Interactive Worlds with JavaScript (Pragmatic Programmers)
item.description:
3D Game Programming for Kids: Create Interactive Worlds with JavaScript

Summary

“3D Game Programming for Kids: Create Interactive Worlds with JavaScript” by Chris Strom is an educational guide focused on teaching young readers the fundamentals of programming through the development of 3D games. The book leverages JavaScript and a web-based platform to introduce basic programming concepts and 3D graphics principles. It is designed to be a hands-on learning experience, encouraging readers to experiment and create their own interactive game worlds. The step-by-step instructions aim to make complex topics accessible and engaging for a younger audience, fostering both creativity and technical skills.

“A Smarter Way to Learn jQuery” by Mark Myers serves as a practical guide for those looking to grasp the essentials of jQuery efficiently. item.title: Getting to Know Vue.js: Learn to Build Single Page Applications in Vue from Scratch
item.description:
Getting to Know Vue.js: Learn to Build Single Page Applications in Vue from Scratch

Summary

“Getting to Know Vue.js: Learn to Build Single Page Applications in Vue from Scratch” by Brett Nelson is a technical guide aimed at helping developers understand and implement Vue.js, a progressive JavaScript framework. The book focuses on building single-page applications (SPAs) from the ground up using Vue.js. It provides a comprehensive walkthrough of core Vue.js concepts, such as Vue components, directives, state management, and routing. The author emphasizes practical learning through hands-on examples and tutorials, making it easier for readers to grasp the fundamental principles and apply them in real-world projects.

item.title: React Explained: Your Step-by-Step Guide to React (2020 Edition)
item.description:
React Explained: Your Step-by-Step Guide to React (2020 Edition)

Summary

“React Explained: Your Step-by-Step Guide to React” by Zac Gordon is an instructional guide designed for both beginners and those with prior programming experience. The book provides a comprehensive walkthrough of React, a popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It covers fundamental concepts such as components, props, state, lifecycle methods, hooks, and context API in a logical and easy-to-understand sequence. The guide is structured to help readers gradually build their skills, using practical examples and exercises to reinforce learning and provide hands-on experience with React development.

item.title: JavaScript: The Definitive Guide: Master the World's Most-Used Programming Language
item.description:
Overview of “JavaScript: The Definitive Guide” by David Flanagan

Summary

“JavaScript: The Definitive Guide” by David Flanagan is widely regarded as one of the most comprehensive resources for mastering JavaScript. The book covers all aspects of the JavaScript programming language, from basic syntax to advanced features. Readers will find in-depth discussions on functions, objects, arrays, modules, and classes. It also covers modern JavaScript features driven by ECMAScript standards, asynchronous programming with promises and async/await, and provides extensive information on JavaScript’s integration with HTML and the DOM API.
